name: mysql-8.0-dependent-subquery
query:
SELECT p.id, p.name,
  (SELECT max(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.unit_price = p.price) AS max_qty
FROM products p
WHERE p.category = 'toys'

-> Select #2 (subquery in projection; dependent)
    -> Aggregate: max(oi.quantity)  (cost=12366 rows=1)
        -> Filter: (oi.unit_price = p.price)  (cost=6379 rows=59866)
            -> Table scan on oi  (cost=6379 rows=598656)
